workarounds.symptom: Remote branches.delete retries a 409 three times and raises "Hit retry limit" instead of the conflict error
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: avoid retrying remote branch deletions. Target files: python/python/lancedb/remote/errors.py, rust/lancedb/src/remote/table.rs, python/python/tests/test_errors.py. Remote branch deletion used the generic retry path, which retries HTTP 409 by default. Deterministic conflicts became retry-limit failures, and a deletion that removed the branch ref before returning HTTP 500 could be replayed and reported as a missing branch. (Ref: https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4854)

workarounds.symptom: bug(python): after alter_columns renames an embedding source column, every add() fails
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: reject renaming or dropping embedding columns. Target files: nodejs/lancedb/table.ts, python/python/lancedb/table.py, rust/lancedb/src/table.rs. Renaming or dropping an embedding source or vector column leaves schema metadata pointing at missing fields, causing later `add()` calls to fail. (Ref: https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4764)

workarounds.symptom: python: Job.wait() gives up on a transient connection error while the job keeps running
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(python): retry transient job polling errors. Target files: python/python/lancedb/job.py, python/python/lancedb/remote/errors.py, python/src/error.rs. Both Python job wait methods propagated transport errors from status polling, even with hours left in the caller's timeout. The server-side job could continue while the client appeared to report a failure. (Ref: https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4774)

workarounds.symptom: python: open_table on a missing remote table raises a plain ValueError with no status_code or request_id
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(python): preserve request metadata for missing remote tables. Target files: python/python/lancedb/remote/errors.py, python/src/error.rs, python/python/tests/test_errors.py. Remote missing-table errors retained their HTTP metadata in Rust, but the Python binding converted them to a plain `ValueError`. This discarded the request ID and status code. (Ref: https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4753)
